source.title: The All-Seeing Eye of Zuldazar
source.objective:
ProgressIf only we had ten-thousand more like you, <name>. The armies of Hakkar would be scattered to the wind in the blink of an eye.

Alas, the Eye is ready to realize its full potential. Give it to me.
source.completion: Smite them all and let Hakkar sort them out...
